name: MonarchAiMentionContext
title: AiMentionContext
wrapsNative: VStack of plain Buttons in an optional ScrollView, shown above the keyboard in a safeAreaInset; MonarchMentionQuery, MonarchAvatar, MonarchInlineErrorRetry, AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
summary: The @ context menu of an AI prompt: documents, people, records and apps that can be added to what the AI sees, grouped by kind, with loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: In an AI composer, when typing @ should add a document, a person, a record or an app to the context the AI sees, shown afterwards with MonarchAiContextChips.
whenNotToUse: For mentioning people or channels in a message to people, use MonarchMentionPicker. For browsing sources without typing, use MonarchAiKnowledgeScope or MonarchAiConnectorPicker.
api: init(_ query: MonarchMentionQuery?, items: [MonarchAiMentionItem], status: MonarchMentionPickerStatus = .ready, labels: MonarchAiMentionContextLabels = MonarchAiMentionContextLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (MonarchAiMentionItem) -> Void)

struct MonarchAiMentionItem: Identifiable { var id: String; var kind: MonarchAiMentionKind; var label: String; var description: String?; var tokens: Int?; var avatarURL: URL?; var isDisabled: Bool; var contextItem: MonarchAiContextItem }
enum MonarchAiMentionKind: String { case doc, person, record, app; var contextKind: MonarchAiContextKind }

struct MonarchAiMentionContextLabels { var label: String?; var group: (@Sendable (MonarchAiMentionKind) -> String)?; var loading: String?; var empty: (@Sendable (String) -> String)?; var error, retry: String?; var tokens: (@Sendable (String, Int) -> String)?; var count: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? }

options.name: query
options.description: The @ query found with MonarchMentionQuery.find(in:caret:triggers:). Nothing is drawn while it is nil.

options.name: items
options.description: The results of the product's search, without ids already in the context.

options.name: status
options.description: loading shows placeholder rows, failed an error, ready the results or the empty text.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Repeats a failed search; adds a retry button to the error.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Receives the chosen result. Add item.contextItem to the context and remove the query from the prompt.

states.name: results
states.description: Rows with an icon or avatar, the label, the description and the token estimate; headings when more than one kind is present.

states.name: searching
states.description: Three redacted placeholder rows; "Searching…" is announced.

states.name: empty
states.description: "Type to search" for an empty query, else "Nothing matches “q3”".

states.name: failed
states.description: "Couldn’t load results.", with a retry button when onRetry is given.

states.name: disabled result
states.description: Dimmed text; the row cannot be chosen.

states.name: closed
states.description: Nothing is drawn while query is nil, or after a query with a space found nothing.

appearance: A full-width strip on the surface colour with a subtle border line above it, like MonarchMentionPicker. Labels are default text, descriptions and token estimates muted, disabled rows the disabled text role. Documents, records and apps show their context-chip symbol on a square tile; people show a round avatar.
platformNotes: The web is a listbox under the caret driven by aria-activedescendant and a hook that wires it into the prompt input. iOS gives no caret position, so this is a strip above the keyboard (the same layout as MonarchMentionPicker) and results are buttons; the product finds the query with MonarchMentionQuery and runs its search in .task(id:). There is no highlighted result or arrow-key navigation. The status reuses MonarchMentionPickerStatus. The parity map called it a mention picker preset; MonarchMentionPicker's items are people and channels only, so this component has its own item type and reuses the picker's query, open rule and layout.
accessibility: Each result is a button read as its label, description and token estimate; a disabled result is dimmed and cannot be activated.
The list is a container named "Add context", with headings marked as headers when more than one kind is present.
"Searching…", the number of results, the empty text and the error are announced as they change, so focus stays in the prompt.
Rows are at least 44 points high and grow with Dynamic Type; icons and avatars are decorative.
edgeCases: More than four results scroll in a height of four and a half rows.
One kind of result shows no heading.
Token counts use the context chips' compact form, for example 12.4K tokens; 1 reads "1 token".
A query with a space that found nothing closes the menu, because the person has moved on.

examples.title: @ adds context chips
A failed search
examples.code:
MonarchAiMentionContext(
    MonarchMentionQuery.find(in: "@q3"),
    items: [],
    status: .failed,
    onRetry: {},
    onSelect: { _ in }
)
